title: Verify Save Template dialog prepopulates current name for an existing user-defined template
steps: Open Plots and load an existing user-defined template (type 2) with a saved name.
Click the Save button in the plot toolbar.
Inspect the Plot Name field in the Save Plot dialog.
expected_results: Existing template is active and name shows in the Plots header.
Plot Name field is automatically populated with the current template name.
label: Critical

title: Verify prepopulated Save dialog name matches the Plots header template title
steps: Load an existing named template and note the header title.
Open Save via the Save button.
Compare header title to the dialog Plot Name value.
expected_results: Dialog Plot Name exactly matches the header template name.
label: Standard

title: Verify Save prepopulation works for an existing Pad plot template
steps: Open an existing Pad/company plot template where Save is enabled.
Click Save and inspect the dialog title.
Inspect Plot Name and Pad Plots checkbox state.
expected_results: Plot Name is prepopulated with the Pad template name and Pad Plots checkbox reflects type 3.
label: Standard

title: Verify unchanged prepopulated name shows warning and disables Save after blur
steps: Open Save for an existing user-defined template with prepopulated current name.
Do not edit the name; click or tab out of the Plot Name field (blur).
Observe inline warning message and Save button state.
expected_results: Name field contains the current template name unchanged.
After blur, duplicate/conflict warning is displayed.
Save button becomes disabled after blur.
label: Critical

title: Verify Save click with unchanged name is blocked even if Save appears enabled on open
steps: Open Save for an existing template with prepopulated unchanged name.
Without blurring the name field, click Save immediately.
Observe whether save proceeds or is blocked.
expected_results: Dialog opens with prepopulated unchanged name.
Save may appear enabled on open before blur.
Save action is blocked; no successful save toast or duplicate create.
label: Standard

title: Verify unchanged-name path does not create a duplicate template list entry
steps: Note template list count for an existing template.
Attempt Save with unchanged prepopulated name so conflict blocks save.
Refresh or reopen the plot list.
expected_results: Save does not complete while name is unchanged and conflict-blocked.
No additional list entry appears for the same template name.
label: Standard

title: Verify editing prepopulated name and saving applies the updated template name
steps: Open Save on an existing template.
Change Plot Name to a new valid unique name and click Save.
Inspect plot list and header for the updated name.
expected_results: Template is saved using the updated name.
label: Critical

title: Verify empty plot name is rejected when clearing a prepopulated name
steps: Open Save on an existing template with prepopulated name.
Clear the Plot Name field completely and click Save.
Observe validation or error feedback.
expected_results: Save is blocked with empty-name error; template is not saved.
label: Standard

title: Verify restricted name surf prc is rejected when editing from prepopulated name
steps: Open Save on an existing template.
Replace the prepopulated name with 'surf prc' and attempt Save.
Observe validation feedback.
expected_results: Save is rejected with existing restricted-name validation.
label: Standard

title: Verify restricted name btm prc is rejected on Save Plot
steps: Open Save on an existing template.
Change name to 'btm prc' and attempt Save.
Observe validation feedback.
expected_results: Save is rejected per existing rules.
label: Standard

title: Verify restricted name measured data is rejected on Save Plot
steps: Open Save on an existing template.
Change name to 'measured data' and attempt Save.
Observe validation feedback.
expected_results: Save is rejected per existing rules.
label: Standard

title: Verify duplicate existing template name conflict when renaming via Save Plot
steps: Open template A and Save with name prepopulated as A.
Change name to an existing different template B name and attempt Save.
Observe conflict validation message.
expected_results: Conflict validation prevents invalid overwrite; Save blocked with conflict message.
label: Standard

title: Verify plot name max length 50 validation applies with prepopulated names
steps: Open Save on an existing template.
Edit name beyond 50 characters or paste over limit.
Attempt Save and observe feedback.
label: Standard

title: Verify whitespace-only name is rejected when replacing prepopulated name
steps: Open Save on an existing template.
Replace name with spaces only and attempt Save.
Observe validation feedback.
expected_results: Save is blocked by non-empty name validation.
label: Standard

title: Verify Rename Plot still prepopulates current name
steps: Open an existing named template.
Use Rename Plot from the plot menu.
Inspect the Plot Name field.
expected_results: Plot Name is prepopulated with the current template name.
label: Regression

title: Verify Cancel on Save Plot does not change the loaded template name
steps: Open Save on an existing template with prepopulated name.
Edit the name optionally, then Cancel without saving.
Confirm active template name unchanged.
expected_results: Active template name and content remain unchanged.
label: Regression

title: Verify reopening Save after Cancel still prepopulates current existing name
steps: Open Save on an existing template and Cancel.
Open Save again on the same template.
Inspect Plot Name.
expected_results: Plot Name is again prepopulated with the current template name.
label: Regression

title: Verify switching from template A to template B updates prepopulated Save name
steps: Open template A, open Save, note name A, close.
Switch to template B and open Save.
Inspect Plot Name.
expected_results: A was prepopulated on first open.
Dialog shows B name not stale A.
label: Regression

title: Verify Duplicate Plot still prepopulates name and content
steps: Open an existing saved template.
Use Duplicate Plot.
Inspect prepopulated name and content handling.
expected_results: Duplicate workflow prepopulates current name/content without regression.
label: Regression

title: Verify channel settings dialog still opens after Save Plot interaction
steps: Open an existing template and open Save Plot once.
Close Save Plot if still open.
Open Channel Selection from Plots toolbar.
expected_results: Channel settings UI opens and remains usable.
label: Regression

title: Verify built-in Fracpro Live+ templates keep Save toolbar disabled
steps: Open a built-in Live+ system plot such as Measured Data or Surf PRC.
Locate the Save toolbar button.
Attempt to click Save or confirm it is disabled.
expected_results: User cannot open Save Plot prepopulation flow from disabled Save for type 0.
label: Regression

title: Verify opening Save Plot does not mutate plot content before Save is clicked
steps: Note current plot channel/configuration state.
Open Save Plot with prepopulated name and Cancel.
Re-check plot configuration.
expected_results: No unintended plot content mutation from merely opening the dialog.
label: Regression

title: Verify end-to-end save with new unique name keeps header and list consistent
steps: Open existing template T, open Save, change to a new valid unique name, Save.
Verify header and sidebar list.
Open Save again and inspect prepopulated name.
expected_results: Header and list show the new name consistently.
Subsequent Save prepopulates the newly saved name.
label: Standard

title: Verify Save and Rename show the same prepopulated name for the same template
steps: Open the same existing template.
Open Rename Plot and note the prepopulated name; close.
Open Save and compare the prepopulated name.
expected_results: Same template context is used for both dialogs.
Rename shows the current template name.
Save shows the identical current template name.
label: Standard

title: Verify user can save after changing prepopulated name to a new unique valid name
steps: Open Save on an existing template with prepopulated name.
Change the name slightly to a new unique valid name and Save.
Confirm list and header reflect the new name.
expected_results: Dialog opens with original name prepopulated.
Template saves under the updated name successfully.
label: Standard
